headline: D-29 'app JVM 60-90s orderly exit' is a MISDIAGNOSIS. The gc,exit block is the normal teardown SIGTERM at test end, not a mid-test death. The JVM stays alive for the whole test; the only network failure in traces is the /chsk reconnect refused AFTER app.close() SIGTERM.
